observation.scope: Two one-off direct GETs to quickview URLs extracted from already saved search HTML; static JS review only; no retries.

observed_behavior: The search card constructs quickviewQuestion via generateUrl({page:0, advanced:undefined, items:[gspDocId], route:Route.quickview, ...}).
gspDocId comes from item.skuInfo.gspDocId, falling back to shop.id/code. The value becomes the `items=` query token.
Opening quickview dispatches fetchQuickviewData with the data-quickview URL.
fetchQuickviewData calls requestData(url,{method:"jsonp",cache:"no-cache",credentials:"include"}) and expects response JSON at modules.ichibaSearch.items, plus modules.itemCoupon.
This is a search route invoked on opening the overlay and may be a partial search result response. Static code does not prove any direct URL response field contents or API semantics.
static_bundle_review.classification: A plausible quickview/search endpoint, not established as an independent product API.
